reviews.text: This place has potential. The amenities are nice, the grounds are beautiful…. But the service is bad all around. I Ordered an iced coffee at 8 am and 9:20 it still had not arrived to my room. I could see if it was a whole breakfast but just a lil coffee?…. Rooms are outdated BUT pretty. The le labo in the rooms is a plus! I’ll be purchasing the lotion it smells lux!! WiFi barely works, pool service is SUPER slow… they asked if we were hungry at 11 am, we say yes! Nobody came back for our order til 1 pm when I finally asked for a server again. Ordered a fruit plate, never got it, was charged for it, had to get it removed but no apology. I will say one of the waitresses at the adults only pool did help by grabbing us a few seats when they were all taken. I am a firm believer that hotel guests should have priority over resort passers etc. Check in took foreverrrrrr…. for a 5 star resort the check in process should feel maybe a bit more luxurious? There was like 20+ people in line. Thanks for the free water tho… Maybe I went on the wrong weekend for it to feel lux… the place seemed big and too much happening with not enough staff. Granted it was a holiday weekend… The restaurants on the resort were great but room service and pool service food was below average. Pizza tasted awful! For the price point, I would probably stay at the Biltmore or Phoenician instead. Wouldn’t stay here again unless it was less than $250 a night
reviews.author: Hannah

reviews.text: Check in is supposed to be at 4pm, they didn't have our room ready for us until after 6pm, which ruined our dinner reservations for our universe as we could not get into our room to get ready as planned. After standing in line for over 30 minutes, I was told they would text me when it was ready and they "apologize for the delay". Five minutes later I received a text from the wanting me to confirm my email for my room charges....(the room I still did not have) I waited in line again about 30 minutes later and was told it was ready. I asked why they didn't let me know, I was told they would text me...he apologized....now I was over the empty apologies and no real care seemingly coming from them so I explained nicely how my anniversary plans of staying at this amazing property and going out to an exclusive reservation only dinner was not going so well and in fact now my dinner reservations would be void as we would not be ready in time because of the 2 hour room delay, and would get charged anyway. He apologized again....I stated that was not going to be good enough at this point and I asked if there is anything else could be done. He said he would put a $100 food and beverage credit attached to my room and whatever we ordered would come off of that first. I was happy with that, although it didnt help he situation...at least it was something I could order a romantic dessert and breakfast with the next day. After check out I received my email invoice and no credit was put on.

reviews.text: This was a quick family getaway for some sun, great food and a little luxury. We found it all here and loved our stay. Beautiful space, luxurious without being pretentious. We found our room and the main areas to be well-maintained and clean. The pools are immaculate and well-attended. Food was awesome. Dinner at Bourbon Steak was unreal. It's a high-end steakhouse with more depth to the menu than a steakhouse normally has. And who doesn't love amazing cocktails??? Our meal was made even better by some of the best service I've enjoyed in any restaurant. Our man Milan was amazing, friendly and could teach a masterclass in sales and customer service. I also wanted to mention Gabriela who handled our check-in with all of the warmth and professionalism that you want when you arrive for your vacation. Highly recommended for families, couples or a getaway with friends.

reviews.text: I was left a little disappointed with the cleanliness of the resort considering it was a 5-Star Fairmont property. There was frequently trash that wasn’t picked up around the pool areas. Empty cups and plates were strewn throughout the property. Just left me asking for more considering how much we paid for our stay. Don’t get me wrong, it’s a nice resort but I’ve stayed at other 5-Star resorts that were cleaner and more attention to the little details.
